input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL used to build links in emails (password reset, rollup, scheduled export) falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set:

    const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";

If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment (e.g. after last week's release changed deployment config), all generated links, including the password reset link, point to localhost instead of the real public domain. The fix is to ensure PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the production environment, and/or to remove the localhost fallback (or fail loudly) so misconfiguration is caught before emails go out.
